monitoring_profile.engine: Ubuntu WSL Docker Engine via the Windows project launcher
monitoring_profile.fleet_overlay: Owned per-attempt override extending the base sender/source bindings
monitoring_profile.durable_queue: Normal per-asset SQLite queue and application persistence receipt
monitoring_profile.replay_scope: Separate reader, credentials, and provenance; independent permission checks

w4_order: At measured t=600 s make the broker unavailable while all ten sources continue.
At t=900 s restore the broker and restart ingestion before crediting any drain.
Start the 120 s recovery clock only when broker and restarted ingestion are both ready. Keep sources and display active and reconcile 3000 outage events and all other measured events.

combined_fault_scenario.mode: Separate single-asset simulation with one actuation authority; operator-only charging candidate and fixture-scoped thermal request
ordered_cases: Qualify healthy monitoring and permitted effects separately with the same registered identity.
Inject cooling degradation and prepare the charging request without releasing it.
Break observation freshness or assert local thermal protection before the grant, then withdraw selected charger power while transport is unavailable.
Recover transport and fresh readings, reconcile original event and command identities, and reject the stale or interrupted handoff.
Use a fresh eligible request or report the blocked outcome. Verify any physical effect from the simulation trace independently.
combined_fault_scenario.requires_before_execution: Dedicated adapter and reviewed one-writer run recipe, exact scenario controls and clock timing, independent witness, authorization for any expansion of automatic dispatch scope

host_launch_precheck.failure_action: Record launch hold; diagnose before another precheck. Offline harness and review work can continue.
